Activity: after swimming she lifts a separate hooded towel away from her shoulders, uncovering her upper back while her opaque swimsuit remains securely in place

Outfit: a saffron asymmetric one-piece swimsuit with an opaque diagonal wrap bodice, a small side-waist cutout and secure wide straps, plus a separate short hooded towel, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
